goals.label: The golf ball drops into the cup

plan.title: Four-stage pendulum to cup machine

items.name: Pendulum
items.why: Stage 1: pulled out 45° to the left. At the release it swings down and its bob, 4 cm above the table at the bottom, strikes the first domino

items.name: Growing domino row
items.why: Stage 2: nine dominoes, each bigger than the last, from 9.8 cm up to about 40 cm tall. The wave gains energy as it runs to the right

items.name: Raised ledge
items.why: Stage 3: a flat shelf whose top is 30 cm up. It starts 4 cm right of the last domino, and the golf ball rolls along it

items.name: Golf ball
items.why: Rests 1 cm in from the ledge's left edge, so the falling 40 cm domino strikes the ball before it strikes the ledge's corner

items.name: Funnel
items.why: Stage 4: its 40 cm mouth sits just under the ledge's right end and catches the ball at any speed. It guides the ball down through its outlet

items.name: Cup
items.why: Finale: the cup stands right under the funnel's outlet, which is about 3 cm above its rim

goals.label: The pendulum strikes the first domino
The last domino strikes the golf ball
The last domino pushes the golf ball along the ledge
The golf ball drops into the cup

plan.notes: The four stages are: (1) the pendulum swings at about 1.7 m/s into the dominoes; (2) the growing row topples; (3) the 40 cm last domino shoves the golf ball along the raised ledge; (4) the ball rolls off the ledge into the funnel, which drops it into the cup. The whole chain takes about 3.5 s.
assumptions: The pendulum, ledge and funnel stand on their own stands or legs, which are part of those items
A golf ball is used because it rolls freely and fits easily through the 8 cm funnel outlet and into the 10 cm cup
A funnel was added before the cup so that the drop works whatever speed the ball leaves the ledge at
I laid the machine out left to right in the order things happen
